title: Day and Trial Passes: blocking a repeat purchase once a tier's rolling-year cap is reached
content:
This document states the basis on which a repeat purchase of a Day and Trial Passes tier is blocked once that tier's rolling-year cap has already been reached, for the tiers of this product line (Single Day Pass, Three-Day Trial Pass, Seven-Day Trial Pass, Weekly Visitor Pass, Monthly Trial Pass, Corporate Guest Pass).

## Rule
A tier whose per-tier rolling-year cap is set above zero may not be purchased again by the same visitor once that visitor already holds that many, or more, passes of that same tier opened within the trailing rolling window ending now. A tier whose per-tier rolling-year cap is zero carries no such block, since no cap applies to it.

### Condition - judgement - action
- Condition: the tier's rolling-year cap is above zero, and the count of that tier's passes the visitor already opened within the trailing rolling window (ending now) has reached or passed that cap.
- Judgement: the cap is exhausted for that tier.
- Result: a further purchase of that same tier by that visitor is not permitted until an existing pass counted in the window ages out of it.

The rolling-year cap value and the length of the rolling window are set per tier; a tier's own cap and window length govern only that tier and are counted independently of every other tier's passes.
